_comment: Hand-kept, reviewed in PRs. The templates: the shells a page, a card, a section, a table or an overlay is built from. Each row keeps only what source cannot say, its group and when to reach for it; the import line and the Storybook page come from the barrels and source, through the DS facts (scripts/lib/ds-facts.mjs). Rendered into components/index.md by npm run generate:agent; scripts/lib/templates-index.mjs holds every name to the facts and every template to a row.

templates.name: Frame
templates.use: Every full page: the app frame (Sidebar, Page with its 12-column content grid, and Panel). Default type: the PLUS `Sidebar` (@/components) in `sidebar`, a `Breadcrumb` in `header`. Bare type: one centered column, no `sidebar`, for sign-in and errors. A multi-step task uses the Sidebar's inner mode, steps as rows, actions in the Page footer.

templates.name: Page
templates.use: A tokenized box with a level (fill and shadow together), a pad and a radius. The Frame draws the page's own; use it for any other block that needs a level.

templates.name: Section
templates.use: A span of the page grid under one heading, with its header, toolbar and tabs. No box of its own: the Page supplies the pad. `detail` for a list with a detail region.

templates.name: Card
templates.use: A raised container for one object: a student, a session, a metric. Optional image, a header over the body, optional footer.

templates.name: Table
templates.use: How a table sits on a page: a Section header over a Static, Dynamic or Tree table, with its footer and empty state.

templates.name: Panel
templates.use: A full-height layer on the right with no Blanket, docked beside the Page when it fits and floating over it when it does not: `PanelContainer` and its parts (`PanelHeader`, `PanelSubheader`, `PanelBody`, `PanelFooter`), filled into the Frame's `panel`. Two types, Details and Notifications. For content that must be dealt with before anything else, use `Modal`.

templates.name: Modal
templates.use: The template for content that takes over the screen until it is closed: a `Dialog` (@/components) on a Blanket with modal behavior on Base UI (portal, focus trap, Escape, scroll lock). For the dialog panel inline with no Blanket or modal behavior, use `Dialog`.

templates.name: Popup
templates.use: The Popups pattern is four floating layers that never block the page, each a component: `DropdownMenu` lists actions, `Popup` holds a small aside anchored to a control, `Flag` reports what just happened, `Tooltip` names a control.

templates.name: AiChat
templates.use: AI chat as a popup, in the Frame's Panel or full screen, opened from one floating button.
